sinopsis.es: Alba, una sanadora y partera solitaria, ha dedicado su existencia a preservar la vida. Guiada por el espíritu de su gato, recibe una noche a una joven desesperada cuya petición sacude sus convicciones. Entre dolor y silencios, deberá comprender que acompañar también significa permitir que cada quien elija su propio camino.
sinopsis.en: Alba, a solitary healer and midwife, has devoted her existence to preserving life. Guided by the spirit of her cat, one night she receives a desperate young woman whose request shakes her convictions. Amid pain and silence, she must understand that being there for someone also means letting each person choose their own path.
